A.title: OPTION A  ·  HARBOUR CITY
A.name: MERIDIAN
A.subtitle: A walled free port of the Triple Alliance. Nine quarters round a central harbour; every lane is busy.
A.concept: Meridian is the Triple Alliance's free port, the richest city on the lanes. It is built like a harbour town: a walled ring 4.6 km across, a docking spire at its heart, and nine quarters between the boulevard and the wall, each run by the people who work there. You arrive from deep space in the inbound stream, behind a liner, with the skyline filling the screen. You pass under the gatehouse towers and the customs scan, and Harbour Control hails you. Everything you can do in the game happens somewhere in the city, for a reason.
strengths: The most city-like: you are surrounded by buildings and traffic everywhere you fly
Every quarter is one flight from the harbour along its avenue: easy to learn, easy to return
Hazards sit where a city would have them: the reactor, the defences, the quarry
costs: The ring layout repeats; districts need strong silhouettes to tell apart
callouts: You spawn here, in the inbound stream, with the city ahead
Harbour Mouth: customs scan, signals, MERIDIAN overhead
Port Authority spire; Harbour Master (the one reset)
Meridian Yards: every ship in a drydock
Proving Range: ships x weapons, targets to 800 m
The Institute: working blocks and mechanisms
The Circuit: start portal to Track 01

districts.name: THE EXCHANGE
districts.purpose: The market quarter. Four trading houses on the Exchange Canal, each with its own trader docked at its berth and its own stock.
contents: TLAXCALA house: bulk goods, fuel, ore; buys everything
KHUCHAD house: weapon blocks
VESTARI house: shields, reactors, high-tech blocks (charges foreigners more)
SWAP: used and salvaged blocks, cheap, under the plane
Haulers load and unload at every berth

districts.name: BREAKERS' YARD
districts.purpose: Shipbreakers. Three hulks on slipways being cut apart by rigs; the debris drifts free for anyone with a magnet.
contents: Salvage loose blocks and sell them at the SWAP
Cutting rigs sweep the slipways (moving arms)
Tugs tow a fresh wreck in every few minutes

districts.name: THE FOUNDRY
districts.purpose: Power and industry. The city's reactor pulses behind blast bulkheads; ore barges come in from the quarry moon.
contents: Reactor pulse: hide in the bulkheads' shadows
Quarry moon's gravity well and the refinery's slow field
The old defence minefield outside the wall: proximity and seeker mines

districts.name: MERIDIAN YARDS
districts.purpose: The shipyard. Every ship in the game sits in a drydock; fly into a dock to take it. The Blueprint Lab is in the yard office.
contents: Drydocks: WRAITH, DIRGE, VESPER, REQUIEM, the racers, the xeno hulls (quarantine dock)
Blueprint Lab: edit your ship
Engine test stand: a cruiser engine fires across the yard on a cycle (engine wash)
New ships launch through the north gate

districts.name: PROVING RANGE
districts.purpose: Weapons testing. Take any ship from the test line, each fitted with a different weapon kit, and fire on targets out to 800 m.
contents: Test line: every ship in every weapon fit
Targets: static hulks, moving rails, drones, a breakable station
Field walls bound the lanes; shoot their emitters to drop them
Turret Alley: run the gauntlet turrets
Scoreboard wall: hits, damage, DPS

districts.name: THE PIT
districts.purpose: The arena. Pick a bout at a gate and fight it in front of the crowd.
contents: Bouts: raider duel, raider wing, xeno swarm, cruiser bout
The bowl's edge is a field wall
The crowd's lights flash on every kill

districts.name: THE INSTITUTE
districts.purpose: The engineering gallery. Every special block and mechanism, working, in its own bay along the flyway.
contents: Prismatic mirror, salvage magnet, portal blocks, shield emitter, reactor
Switch and blast door, sweeper arm, rails
Repulsor, EMP, seeker, gravity and proximity mines; energy canisters; impact driver

districts.name: THE CIRCUIT
districts.purpose: The racing quarter. Racers line up in the pit lane; the start portal outside the wall opens onto Track 01.
contents: Race the AI on Track 01 (Battle Graveyard)
Leaderboard on the grandstand

districts.name: THE HARBOUR
districts.purpose: Port Authority. The spire, the docking ring and sixteen piers where liners and freighters dock. The Harbour Master's console resets the whole city.
contents: Liners, freighters and barges dock, dwell and leave all the time
Harbour Master: reset the city
Harbour Control hails you on the way in

districts.name: HARBOUR MOUTH
districts.purpose: The way in. Gatehouse towers, the customs scanner and traffic signals over the inbound and outbound lanes.
contents: Customs scan sweeps you as you pass
Signals hold traffic when the mouth is busy

districts.name: OLD TOWN
districts.purpose: Habitation spires, the skyline. No gameplay; life.

B.title: OPTION B  ·  THE KEEL
B.name: THE KEEL
B.subtitle: A city grown along the 5.4 km keel of the colony ship that brought people here.
B.concept: The colony ship that brought the first settlers never left. Its 5.4 km keel became a street, its ribs became the city's blocks, and three centuries of building filled the bays between them. Traffic runs up the east flank and down the west, and through the keel's own arches. You arrive at the bow and look up the whole length of the city, its lights running away into the distance. The ship's reactor still pulses and its stern engines still fire.
strengths: The grandest arrival: the whole city in one long perspective
A single spine is impossible to get lost on
The ship's own history explains the reactor and the engine wash
costs: Linear: the far end is 5 km from the bow
Districts on a flank feel like bays, less like quarters of a city
callouts: You spawn on the east flank lane, looking up the keel
The Bow: Port Authority and the liner cradle

districts.name: THE EXCHANGE
districts.purpose: Four trading houses in the first bays behind the bow, two on each flank.
contents: TLAXCALA, KHUCHAD, VESTARI, SWAP, each with its own stock and trader

districts.name: OLD TOWN
districts.purpose: Habitation towers on the ribs; the skyline.

districts.name: KEEL YARDS
districts.purpose: Drydocks between the ribs; take any ship.
contents: Blueprint Lab in the yard office

districts.name: PROVING RANGE
districts.purpose: The test line on the west flank fires out into open space.
contents: Ships x weapon kits
Targets to 800 m
Field walls

districts.name: THE PIT
districts.purpose: The arena, slung between two ribs.
contents: Four bouts

districts.name: THE INSTITUTE
districts.purpose: The gallery of working blocks between the ribs.
contents: Fourteen exhibits

districts.name: THE FOUNDRY
districts.purpose: The keel's original reactor, still running; it pulses through the bays.
contents: Reactor pulse and shadows

districts.name: THE CIRCUIT
districts.purpose: Pit lane and grandstand; the start portal off the west flank.

districts.name: BREAKERS' YARD
districts.purpose: The keel's broken stern, being cut up for parts. Its engines still fire aft.
contents: Salvage
Engine wash off the stern
Old minefield beyond

districts.name: THE BOW
districts.purpose: Port Authority on the bow; liners dock in the cradle.
contents: Harbour Master: reset

C.title: OPTION C  ·  THE CROWN
C.name: THE CROWN
C.subtitle: Station islands round an Aksharan gate, 1.3 km high, that still works.
C.concept: Nobody built the Crown. It is an Aksharan gate, a hoop 1.3 km across standing through the plane, and it still opens onto other systems. A city of station islands grew around it to tax what comes through. Ships arrive in a flash between its feet every few seconds. The Vestari say it is holy and keep a sanctum at its foot; everyone else just trades.
strengths: The strongest landmark in the game: a 1.3 km gate rising toward the camera
Arrivals are a show: ships flash in through the gate all the time
costs: Islands with open space between them: less like a city, more like an archipelago
The gate's lore commits the mystery (the Aksharans) early
callouts: You spawn on the approach, the hoop rising ahead
The Crown: ships arrive through the Aksharan gate in flashes
